title: Finish Ultimate Plus Material Care Dishwashing Tablets 80 Pack $39 @ Woolworths
body:
Deal: Finish Ultimate Plus Material Care Dishwashing Tablets 80 Pack $39 @ Woolworths

[Stewardo] It’s pretty expensive, you should be looking around 30c per capsule for this type of Finish product.
[happydude] No, Woolies does the same thing they do with Coke. The 30 can block is on sale, then the 10 can pack, then the 1.25, then the……
There are 7 Ultimate Plus products. They cycle through different products (scent/quantity) making sure one "discounted" each and every week.
The Every Day Low price version is 52c each, this deal is 49c. - https://www.woolworths.com.au/shop/productdetails/6066011/fi…
Real deals like this had them down to 22c each. That was a deal. https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/964038
[Kommodore] Its called the half price model, they literally just doubled stuff to 1/2 price it every other week. End price or price per ea is all that matters.
Didn't someones holiday pic in Europe go viral a few months ago where these same brand tablets were like 9 Euro or something normal price.
[justtoreply] These suck. They don't dissolve very well vs the previous formula
[djkelly69] Haha save $45!! Even though the price for the 90 pack is $47 everyday!
(Yes I can maths, I realise this is slightly cheaper per unit, but not by much and is just so deliberately misleading.)
[ltzJack] Just get Woolies home brand Shine dishwasher powder, they lowered the price to $3.70 recently, less than $0.08 per wash.
